programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Stop the Falling Space Junk; Pups Stop the Giant Cuckoo
programs.desc: When Digi and Tal's space vacuum breaks, it's up to the pups to save Mayor Humdinger from falling space debris; Humdinger's cuckoo clock goes out of control; Ryder and the Pups must rescue Travis and get control of the cuckoo to save Humdinger.

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.sub_title: Mr. Bull Is Getting Married; Getting Ready for a Wedding; The Wedding Day; Party Bus; Families
programs.desc: Mr. Bull and Mrs. Cow are getting married; everyone gets ready for the wedding; the day of Mrs. Cow and Mr. Bull's wedding arrives; Peppa gets an invitation to Candy Cat's birthday party; the children draw family pictures.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Pups Save a Runaway Robo-Chicken Purse; Pups Save the Buggy Trekkers
programs.desc: Digi and Tal's inventions to help a busy Mayor Goodway go haywire and lead to a wild woodland chase; when Mayor Humdinger squeezes himself into the Trekkers' friendly dune buggy race, his cheating ways put the other racers in jeopardy.

programs.title: Rubble & Crew
programs.sub_title: The Crew Builds A Stadium Dome
programs.desc: When Speed Meister rains on the Builder Cove Sing-Off, Rubble & Crew saves the show by building a giant dome over the stadium!

programs.title: Mr. Crocodile
programs.desc: Mr. Crocodile goes overboard to impress Daisy's granny when she comes to visit.

programs.title: PAW Patrol
programs.sub_title: Aqua Pups Save a Merdinger; Aqua Pups Save the Whale Patroller
programs.desc: When Humdinger disguises himself to steal the purple pearl, the PAW Patrol must return it to Puplantis; after Moby steals the Whale Patroller and all the Pups' vehicles with it, the pups climb aboard sea creatures to chase it down.
